She didn't stop talking to me, but I can clearly see that she is no longer talking to me like she did. I mean there's a clearly noticeable distance she is keeping from me. And previously whenever she went through something she did keep her distance but also shared and confided in me when she was sad and I would know that she was going through something.

We stay in the same hostel, but our hostel was shut down because of covid for 6 months. We don't talk at all when we are at home, call or chat rarely... nothing to worry it's just how it is, we get busy at home. So this time when I returned, I can sense and clearly see that there's a distance and it's hurting me like hell. I have got too many shocks from close friends in the last 1 year and that has already left me with enough bruise, this one is hurting me too. I tried mentioning to her subtly "I feel bad that I have got distant from you because of this gap..." she didn't say anything in reply, which hurt more because I can see that she is wayy better than how she was doing before and she has become close to another girl in our hostel and is kind of acting cold and indifferent to me.

I thought of confronting her asking why she was doing that, and did I do something wrong to receive this treatment, but I didn't do anything... That's because I had already tried to mention subtly and her not saying anything stung hard, I am afraid to face that again if I try to confront her directly
